cards.stem: What range of quoted values was reported for the coefficient due to measuring inaccuracies?
cards.quote: Because of measuring inaccuracies at the time, there were many quoted values for the coefficient ranging from .0027 to .005.
cards.hint: Recall the range mentioned for early measurements.

cards.stem: What weight was the aircraft itself expected to lift in the design case for the early kite test?
cards.quote: The 1901 aircraft had been designed to lift itself (100 pounds) plus a pilot
cards.hint: Think about the design weight for the aircraft alone.

cards.stem: What value did the brothers find more closely approximated their data for the Smeaton coefficient?
cards.quote: they determined that a value of .0033 more closely approximated their data.
cards.hint: Consider the revised value found from flight data.

cards.stem: What factor did wind tunnel tests reveal as important for the lift coefficient?
cards.quote: the brothers discovered the importance of wing shape on the lift coefficient
cards.hint: Focus on what wind tunnel testing showed about geometry.
